articles.title_en: Richard Wagner and his connection to Czechia, from Teplice to Prague's theatres
articles.lead_en: Richard Wagner had a strong connection to Czechia, from the spa town of Teplice to Prague’s theatres. articles.title_en: Deště z posledního měsíce doplnily vláhu v horní vrstvě půdy. V hloubce a v tocích však sucho zůstává

articles.title_en: Hádka Kyjeva s Budapeští. Magyar odmítl Karpatskou osmu, podle Ukrajiny je jako Orbán

articles.title_en: Designer on Petřín’s new cable cars: “I was like, Oh my God, it’s working!”
articles.lead_en: New cable cars have just entered operation on Prague’s Petřín Hill. The glass-heavy cars afford spectacular views of the city and boast cool details; for instance when they pass, those going up “wink” (flash their lights), while those going down “blush” (light up red inside).
